description_en: Queries the details of batch intelligent one-click video production jobs, including the input parameters, task status, and the IDs and URLs of the produced media assets. This operation supports querying only task data from the past year
description_zh: 获取批量智能一键成片作业的详细信息，包括作业的输入参数、任务状态、合成的媒资ID及URL。本接口仅支持查询近一年的任务数据
name: GetBatchMediaProducingJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the batch intelligent one-click video production job
parameters.help_zh: 批量智能一键成片作业ID
parameters.name: job_id

EditingBatchJob.description_en: The batch intelligent one-click video production task information
EditingBatchJob.description_zh: 批量智能一键成片任务信息

CompleteTime.description_en:
The time when the task was completed. The time is displayed in UTC.

Format: "YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"
CompleteTime.description_zh:
任务完成时间，格式为utc时间。

格式为："YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，UTC 时间格式

EditingConfig.description_en: The editing-related configuration. For more information about the structure, see [EditingConfig](~~2692547#1be9bba03b7qu~~)
EditingConfig.description_zh: 剪辑相关配置。具体结构定义，请参见[EditingConfig](~~2692547#1be9bba03b7qu~~)配置说明

Extend.description_en:
The extended information. Field details:

ErrorCode: the error code of the main task

ErrorMessage: the error message of the main task
Extend.description_zh:
扩展信息。字段详情：

ErrorCode: 主任务错误码

ErrorMessage: 主任务错误信息

ExtendInput.description_en:
The additional input.
If JobType is set to Smart_Mix_Timeline_Organize or Screen_Media_Highlights_Timeline_Organize, the additional input is the media selection result.
If JobType is set to Scene_Batch_Editing, the additional input is the list of editing project IDs
ExtendInput.description_zh:
额外输入。
JobType = Smart_Mix_Timeline_Organize 或 Screen_Media_Highlights_Timeline_Organize 时，额外输入为素材挑选结果。
JobType = Scene_Batch_Editing 时，额外输入为剪辑工程id列表

ExtendOutput.description_en:
The additional output.
If JobType is set to Smart_Mix_Media_Select or Screen_Media_Highlights_Media_Select, the media selection result is additionally returned
ExtendOutput.description_zh:
额外输出。
JobType = Smart_Mix_Media_Select 或 Screen_Media_Highlights_Media_Select 时，额外返回素材挑选结果

InputConfig.description_en: The user synthesis output configuration. For more information about the structure, see [InputConfig](~~2692547#2faed1559549n~~)
InputConfig.description_zh: 用户合成输出配置。具体结构定义，请参见[InputConfig](~~2692547#2faed1559549n~~)配置说明

JobType.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:
Script: scripted automatic video production
Smart_Mix: intelligent image and text matching video production
Sports_Highlights: sports event highlights video production
Screen_Media_Highlights: high-energy mashup video production
Smart_Mix_Media_Select: intelligent matching - media selection
Smart_Mix_Timeline_Organize: intelligent matching - timeline arrangement
Screen_Media_Highlights_Media_Select: high-energy mashup - media selection
Screen_Media_Highlights_Timeline_Organize: high-energy mashup - timeline arrangement
Scene_Batch_Editing: multi-timeline batch synthesis
JobType.description_zh:
任务类型：
Script（脚本化自动成片）
Smart_Mix（智能图文匹配成片）
Sports_Highlights（体育赛事集锦成片）
Screen_Media_Highlights（高燃混剪成片）
Smart_Mix_Media_Select（智能匹配--素材挑选）
Smart_Mix_Timeline_Organize（智能匹配--时间线编排）
Screen_Media_Highlights_Media_Select（高燃混剪--素材挑选）
Screen_Media_Highlights_Timeline_Organize（高燃混剪--时间线编排）
Scene_Batch_Editing（多时间线批量合成）

ModifiedTime.description_en:
The time when the task was modified. The time is displayed in UTC.

Format: "YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"
ModifiedTime.description_zh:
任务修改时间，格式为utc时间。

格式为："YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"

OutputConfig.description_en: The output configuration. For more information about the structure, see [OutputConfig](~~2692547#447b928fcbuoa~~)
OutputConfig.description_zh: 输出配置。具体结构定义，请参见[OutputConfig](~~2692547#447b928fcbuoa~~)配置说明

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Init: initialized

Processing: processing

Finished: finished
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值范围：

Init：初始化

Processing：处理中

Finished: 处理完成

SubJobList.description_en: The list of one-click video production subtasks

items.description_en: The one-click video production subtask information

Duration.description_en: The duration of the produced video. Unit: seconds

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the subtask fails. This parameter is not returned if the subtask is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 失败时错误码。如果执行成功则不返回此参数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the subtask fails. This parameter is not returned if the subtask is successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 失败时错误信息。如成功则不返回此参数

MediaId.description_en: The ID of the produced media asset

MediaURL.description_en: The URL of the output video file

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the cloud editing project

Status.description_en:
The subtask status. Valid values:

Init: initialized

Processing: processing

Success: successful

Failed: failed
Status.description_zh:
子任务状态。取值范围：

Init：初始化

Processing：处理中

Success：成功

Failed： 失败

UserData.description_en: The user business and callback configurations. For more information about the structure, see [UserData](~~357745#section-urj-v3f-0s1~~)
UserData.description_zh: 用户业务配置、回调配置。具体结构定义，请参见[UserData](~~357745#section-urj-v3f-0s1~~)配置说明
